items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex down 300 pts, Nifty around 23,050; Jindal Saw drops over 7%

items.title: ​LTCG tax cut alone won't lure FPIs, says Bernstein; Nifty target cut to 25k
items.description: A sharp 1-2 day market rally that an LTCG cut would trigger may actually be used to offload positions, Bernstein said in an October 19 note.

items.title: Urban Company shares fall 10% as Q2 net loss widens despite revenue growth
items.description: Urban Company's consolidated net loss widened to ₹182.48 crore in the July-September quarter of FY27. The company had posted a net loss of ₹59.33 crore in the year-ago period.

items.title: Nifty PSU Bank index surges 3%; PNB, PSB, Canara, Union Bank soar up to 8%
items.description: At 09:49 AM on Monday, the Nifty PSU Bank index was top gainer among sectoral indices, up 2.6 per cent, as compared to 0.02 per cent decline in the Nifty 50.

items.title: Axis Bank shares fall 5% despite 39% rise in Q2 net profit; here's why
items.description: MOFSL said that Axis Bank's elevated opex led to slight earnings miss in Q2. The strong NII growth and lower-than-expected provisions were offset by elevated opex and softer treasury income.

items.title: Karur Vysya Bank hits new lifetime high, up 8% in two days post Q2 results
items.description: Karur Vysya Bank's share price hit a record high of ₹375 in Monday's trading session on the NSE. Equirus Securities and Elara Capital pegged upside targets of ₹400 and ₹415, respectively.

items.title: HDFC Bank falls 1.5% post Q2 show; analysts say worst over; eyes on new CEO
items.description: HDFC Bank share price: HDFC Bank reported a 4.7 per cent year-on-year (YoY) increase in net profit to ₹19,510 crore in the second quarter of FY27.

items.title: ICICI Bank gains 1% post Q2 results; analysts upbeat on asset quality
items.description: ICICI Bank reported a 20.1 per cent year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to ₹14,843 crore in the July-September quarter of FY27.

items.title: Mutual fund inflows insufficient to lift markets: Manish Jain, Choice AMC
items.description: Manish Jain, Deputy CEO of Choice AMC has said that mutual fund inflows are not sufficient to lift the market alone. He added that domestic money sets the floor only, and not the ceiling.

items.title: Sebi's CAS rollback may offer new lifeline to Indian derivatives market
items.description: The reversal could provide a much-needed boost to a market grappling with regulatory curbs aimed at reining in speculative trading

items.description: Stocks to buy today: Sachin Gupta, VP - research , Choice Equity Broking, recommends three stocks to buy today, namely Groww, HCL Tech and Nazara Technologies.

items.title: UltraTech Cement tanks 5% from day's high post Q2 results; key details
items.description: UltraTech Cement on Monday reported a 21.3% surge in Q2 consolidated net profit, backed by 18.8% growth in revenue from operations.

items.title: Volume shockers: Jana Small Finance tumbles 14%; Federal Bank soars 5%
items.description: Share price of Jana Small Finance Bank slumped 14% to ₹424.30 on the BSE in Monday's intraday deals amid reports that Federal Bank was not in active talks for a stake buy.

items.title: Eternal Q2 preview: Brokerages expect market share gains, steady margins

items.title: Union Bank shares jump 5% as Q2 PAT rises 30% YoY, asset quality improves

items.title: Kross share price zooms 20%, hits record high on huge volume; here's why

items.title: HFCL hits 5% upper circuit after 'best-ever' quarterly show; Q2 PAT up 448%

items.title: Laurus Labs zooms 128% from March low; hits new high in weak market

items.title: Banks tap RBI's first cash auction in 3 months as market rates spike

items.title: Shree Renuka, Balrampur & others fall up to 6%; why are sugar stocks down?

items.title: Trend reversal? Analyst decodes Havells India, NTPC, Birlasoft on charts
items.description: NTPC stock is showing early signs of a potential reversal, as it trades near its long-term support (200-week EMA) on the charts, says Sachin Gupta of Choice Broking.

items.title: Cyient DLM plunges 24% in two days; what's making the Street nervous?
